summary: Clean kitchen space with minor risks from heavy cookware placed near the island edge.

hazards.title: Heavy pot lid near edge
hazards.detail: Cast iron lid rests near the counter perimeter and could fall, risking foot injury.
fixSteps: Move the lid farther inward away from the island edge.
Store the lid directly on the pot when not in use.

hazards.title: Unsecured Dutch oven placement
hazards.detail: Large heavy pot sitting on a cloth near edge poses spill or pull-down risk.
fixSteps: Push cookware toward the center of the kitchen island.
Remove loose cloth mats that can be accidentally pulled.
